Applicants need at least 25 years of professional experience in the Coal/Thermal sector. Officers of Organized Group 'A' Services may also apply. The appointment is for an initial term of two years. Applications in the prescribed format, in duplicate, must be received by the Joint Secr

qualification.details: Bachelor's degree in Engineering i.e., BE/B.Tech (Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mining) from a recognized University/ Institute /equivalent Degree in the subject directly relevant to the position.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed format attached to the notification (Appendix to Notification No. 02/JS(Per)/2026). Affix a photograph and sign across it.
Prepare the application in duplicate, with relevant copies of enclosures as per the check list below.
Superscribe the post applied for: Director (Coal & Logistics).
Address the application to: The Joint Secretary, 3rd Floor, Vidyut Soudha, APGENCO, Vijayawada – 520 004.

If you are in Government service, forward the application through proper channel with a "No objection Letter" from the Controlling officer/Head of Department. The forwarding authority must certify that the entries have been verified from records and that no disciplinary/vigilance proceedings are pending or contemplated and no major/minor penalties were imposed during the last ten years (the last page of the form is filled by the PSU/Ministry/Department concerned).
If you are retired, submit the application directly and ensure that the relevant documents required from your previous employer are forwarded, as applicable.
Make sure the application reaches the address by 25 November 2026, 5.30 PM. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained.
Application form in the prescribed proforma as annexed to the notification, in duplicate.
Attested copies in support of Age, Qualifications, Nationality and Caste.
Certificate of Educational Qualification along with marks sheets of all the years.
Certificates in support of the experience mentioned in the application form.

ACRs/CRs for the last 5 years where worked (for Central/State Government/Government undertaking employees: up-to-date and complete CR or ACR for the last five years, in original or attested Xerox copies).
NOC, in case of Central/State Govt/Government undertaking employees, if the application is not forwarded through proper channel.
important_instructions: Applications received without the CR dossiers/ACRs and vigilance clearance, or with incomplete information, will not be entertained. APGENCO will not entertain any information furnished by the candidate after submission. If any information is found false, incomplete or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature or appointment will be revoked or terminated at any stage, even after selection or joining. Candidates must not furnish false, tampered or fabricated information or suppress material information. Under the declaration, a candidate who gives unwillingness after the interview, before the appointment is processed or after the offer of appointment, may be debarred for two years from consideration for a Board level post in any PSU under the administrative control of the Energy Department, Govt. of A.P., other than his or her own. APGENCO reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification and/or the recruitment process without assigning any reason. Only the Courts, Tribunals/Forums at Vijayawada have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from this notification.

content_sections.heading: About APGENCO
content_sections.text: APGENCO was incorporated under the Indian Companies Act, 1956 as a wholly owned State Government Company and is engaged in power generation in Andhra Pradesh. According to the notification, its installed capacity is 8789 MW, made up of 6610 MW Thermal, 1773.6 MW Hydro and 405.4 MW Solar power stations. Besides operating and maintaining its power plants, it is executing new projects under its capacity addition programme and renovating older power stations. Andhra Pradesh Power Development Corporation Limited (APPDCL) and APSPCL are its subsidiaries.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Engineering i.e., BE/B.Tech (Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mining) from a recognized University/ Institute /equivalent Degree in the subject directly relevant to the position. Post Graduate in Engineering in the same discipline/MBA of 2 years duration/ Ph.D., from a recognised University/institution. At least 25 years of professional experience in the Coal/Thermal sector with Central/State Government/Public Sector undertakings. Of these 25 years, at least 15 years of experience in Construction, Designing, Development, Operation & Maintenance of Thermal Power Plants/Coal mines. Of these 15 years, at least 3 years of cumulative service at senior level positions of General Manager/Superintending Engineer and Chief Engineer/Chief General Manager/Executive Director, or an equivalent rank, in the Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings of the Coal/Thermal sector, as on the date of Notification. OR Officers of Organized Group 'A' Services (such as IRTS/IRMS etc.) of the Central Government/State Government working at the appropriate level are exempted from the educational qualifications above. They should have at least 5 years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in Coal Procurement/Coal Linkage Management, Coal Mining, Railway Freight and Rake Management, Port Operations, Transportation and Logistics, Fuel Supply Agreements, Coal Quality Management, Materials/Supply Chain Management, and/or associated Commercial and Contract Management functions. They have to work on deputation as per the terms and conditions of deputation of their parent department. The maximum age for the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post is 65 years, as on the date of Notification (2 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The candidate should have sound health. In the application's declaration, the applicant certifies that he or she has not been disqualified to act as a Director under Section 274 or any other relevant section of the Indian Companies Act, 1956. The applicant also certifies that he or she is not facing any charge of, nor has ever been convicted for, any act of moral turpitude or economic offence. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Tenure: Initially for a term of two years. The tenure may be extended for one year at a time, up to a maximum of two extensions. Extension decisions: Made after approval of the competent authority, on the recommendation of the Selection Committee, based on the Director's yearly assessment report. Only candidates with an outstanding assessment should be considered for re-appointment. Government servants: A person selected who is already a Government servant will have to seek retirement and retire before appointment. Group 'A' Service officers: Work on deputation as per the terms and conditions of deputation of their parent department. Place of work: APGENCO Corporate Office, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in APGENCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Director (Coal & Logistics), under Notification No. 02/JS(Per)/2026 dated 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 25 November 2026, 5.30 PM. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering i.e., BE/B.Tech (Electrical/Mechanical/Mining) or an equivalent degree in a subject directly relevant to the position, plus at least 25 years of experience in the Coal/Thermal sector. Organized Group 'A' Service officers are exempted from the educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the APGENCO Director post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years, as on the date of Notification (2 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics)?
faq.answer: The lumpsum amount is Rs. 3,75,955 per month including DA, HRA & CCA (minus pension). The allowances listed are Security Guard Allowance Rs. 20,598, Telephone Operator Allowance Rs. 20,598, Prof. Development Allowance Rs. 20,000, Special allowance Rs. 25,000 and Camp office allowance Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for APGENCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, in duplicate, with the check-list enclosures and the post name superscribed, to The Joint Secretary, 3rd Floor, Vidyut Soudha, APGENCO, Vijayawada – 520 004. In-service applicants must apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the APGENCO Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their experience profile for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is initially for a term of two years. The term may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum of two extensions, based on the yearly assessment report.

faq.question: Q9. Can Organized Group 'A' Service officers apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Officers of Organized Group 'A' Services (such as IRTS/IRMS) working at the appropriate level may apply. They need at least 5 years of cumulative senior-level experience in the listed coal and logistics areas during the last ten years and will work on deputation.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must Government employees enclose?
faq.answer: Government and Government undertaking employees must enclose up-to-date CRs/ACRs for the last five years (original or attested copies) and vigilance clearance. Applications without these will not be entertained.
